purpose: Amend only the transport payload size used for the remote cross-chat canary because the current Dropbox connector exposes text create but no direct runtime-file or binary-upload action.
constraint_observed: Dropbox connector can create UTF-8 text files up to 5MB but does not expose a byte-preserving upload from /mnt/data or a direct binary upload action. Therefore the current runtime cannot inject the 2.8MB and 2.18MB Base64 strings for part_04.npz into Dropbox without serializing those strings through the model/tool argument surface.

amendment.generator: chunk_i = first_1024_bytes_of_SHA256(counter||i) stream with counter encoded uint64 big-endian, concatenating SHA256 blocks until 1024 bytes
amendment.reason: The cross-chat canary is intended to validate locator discovery, durable-store readback, manifest-driven ordering, Base64 decode, raw-hash verification, full-artifact reconstruction, and fail-closed behavior. Production-size transport margin and exact reconstruction of the real 16 M30 NPZ payloads were already validated locally on the actual bytes in QROS_CAS_PROTOCOL_LOCAL_VALIDATION_v1. The two concerns are intentionally separated.
